name: 哔哩哔哩 / Bilibili
description: Video search, captions, parts, comments and creator uploads / B站视频检索、字幕查看、分P定位、评论与UP主研究

workflows.title: Search and filter videos / 视频搜索与筛选
workflows.description: Search from the homepage, choose result types, apply duration, recent-half-year and publication-order controls, and identify video candidates.

workflows.title: Read video details and captions / 视频详情与字幕
workflows.description: Identify a video and creator, read visible metadata and description, pause playback and inspect an available caption cue.

workflows.title: Navigate video parts / 分P与合集定位
workflows.description: Select a named part in a collection sidebar and verify the resulting BV ID, part parameter, title and player duration.

workflows.title: Read comments and reply pages / 评论与楼中楼
workflows.description: Load the comment area, switch latest ordering, expand a root comment's replies and navigate reply pages.

workflows.title: Search creator uploads / UP主空间与投稿
workflows.description: Open the video's public creator space, inspect uploads and search within that creator's content.
